# Downloader by The Atom

Downloader by The Atom is a premium, 100% free, and completely ad-free web-based media downloader. It provides a direct, clean utility to inspect public media URLs, extract direct audio/video streams, merge high-definition video files with audio tracks, and download them. The project is created by Zaki Sheriff under the digital product studio The Atom (https://theatom.lk).

## Creator & Developer
- **Founder & Creator**: Zaki Sheriff
- **Product Studio**: The Atom (https://theatom.lk)
- **Product Website**: https://downloader.theatom.lk

## Key Features
- **Media Inspector**: Fetches real-time media title, description, duration, and uploader names.
- **Direct & Adaptive Downloads**: Decrypts stream signatures and serves direct format files (MP4, WEBM, MP3).
- **HD Video Merging**: Dynamically merges high-resolution video tracks (1080p, 1440p (2K), 2160p (4K)) with high-quality audio files server-side using FFmpeg.
- **Audio Extraction**: Converted direct audio format outputs (MP3 conversions up to 320kbps).
- **Tactile User Interface**: Custom responsive interface featuring liquid glass styling, glassmorphism blur layers, and Lenis smooth scrolling.

## System Safeguards & Limits
To support ad-free, zero-cost public hosting, the downloader integrates several server-side safeguards:
- **Job Concurrency Queue**: Restricts server merging and heavy tasks to a maximum of **3 concurrent tasks** globally. Staged tasks wait in a FIFO queue.
- **IP Rate Limiting**: Restricts clients to a maximum of **5 download/merge attempts per hour** using sliding-window tracking.
- **Duration Cap**: Automatically blocks inspection and downloads of video/audio files exceeding **30 minutes** (1,800 seconds).
- **Automated Garbage Collection**: Performs automatic temp storage purges and job-state cache cleanups every **10 minutes** (deleting files older than 30 minutes).
- **Flat-Memory Streaming**: Pipes read streams directly from the server storage using Web Streams, handling browser aborted connections instantly to prevent memory leaks and out-of-memory crashes.

## Design Aesthetic
- **Borders & Curve Radius**: Standardized `35px` border curves for cards, text fields, and primary buttons.
- **Liquid Glass Integration**: Tactile iOS-inspired 3D liquid glass card covers and interactive buttons with customizable intensity, shimmer, and depth levels.
- **Theme**: Premium neutral dark styling overlaying an off-white background (#fafafa).
